explication: EasyAnimate is a high-resolution, long-video generation and model-training system. Its primary workflow accepts prompts and optional image, video, or control inputs through the UI/API or ComfyUI, runs a generation pipeline, and returns generated video. Separate branches cover dataset preparation and captioning, DiT/LoRA and VAE training, control/inpainting, and reward-based optimization. The README documents these capabilities; some branches are represented at their directory or entry-script level because their implementation was not sampled.
